audience: humans and agents adopting an optional doc register submodule
maintainers who want glossary-backed feature pages without a heavy frontend
problem: Module documentation scatters across folders and chat; people cannot quickly answer what a term means or which files belong to a feature.
solution: DGM ships a pin-as-submodule HTML + vanilla JS hub: a global citation register and per-feature pages that show a human glossary then associated files, with explore clicks gated through jev-ultrafast.
mechanism: explore/index.html loads register.json and lists citation links into feature pages
each feature page renders glossary terms then an associated file list
scripts/run_explore_click_gate.py documents and invokes the jev-ultrafast click path
continuity + helper adapter files keep agent installs full-stack without vendoring helper trees
